scripts.build: graph codegen && graph build && node scripts/predictions.mjs build
scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts predictions/src predictions/tests
scripts.typecheck: graph codegen && graph build && graph build subgraph.testnet.yaml --output-dir build/testnet && node scripts/predictions.mjs build && tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler scripts/check-points.ts
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && graph codegen && graph test --version 0.6.0 && node scripts/predictions.mjs test
